description: This file defines the DeprecatedHttpService class, a wrapper for XMLHttpRequests used for making HTTP requests with various methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE). It includes methods for creating and sending requests, handling responses, and managing headers, specifically tailored for the StandardNotes project.

classes.name: DeprecatedHttpService
classes.description: A wrapper class for XMLHttpRequests providing methods for HTTP operations, response handling, and request configuration.

methods.name: getAbsolute
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified URL with optional parameters and authentication.

methods.name: postAbsolute
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to the specified URL with optional parameters and authentication.

methods.name: putAbsolute
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request to the specified URL with optional parameters and authentication.

methods.name: patchAbsolute
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request to the specified URL with parameters and optional authentication.

methods.name: deleteAbsolute
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the specified URL with optional parameters and authentication.

methods.name: runHttp
methods.description: Executes the HTTP request based on the provided HttpRequest object.

methods.name: createRequestBody
methods.description: Creates the request body based on the HttpRequest's parameters and verb.

methods.name: createXmlRequest
methods.description: Initializes and configures an XMLHttpRequest object with headers and URL.

methods.name: runRequest
methods.description: Sends the XMLHttpRequest and returns a promise resolving with the response.

methods.name: stateChangeHandlerForRequest
methods.description: Handles the XMLHttpRequest state change, processes response headers and body, and resolves or rejects the promise accordingly.

methods.name: urlForUrlAndParams
methods.description: Constructs a URL with query parameters appended.
